description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the wedges order.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    </bpmn:task>

      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerStatus" name="Burger preparation complete?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BurgerAndUpdatesJoin" name="Burger and updates complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAskMenu" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenu"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuToAskSide" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSide"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideToReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSideToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMergeToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoinToMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuMergeToBurgerSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuMerge" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerAndUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerSplitToPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerAndUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerAndUpdatesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="End_OrderDelivered"/>
